status_vocabulary.complete: the requested audit and its comparison evidence exist
status_vocabulary.partial: some exact evidence exists, but the end-to-end pass condition is not met
status_vocabulary.open: the alternative or measurement required by the pass condition does not exist
status_vocabulary.rejected: the tested candidate is correct but loses the stated cost gate

hard_rule: A technique counts only when it removes real instructions, memory traffic, or end-to-end cycles; source-code presence is not a pass.
